windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7/8 - Candidate and Instance deployment preconditions
scope: Read-only confirmation of the exact dispatcher/ref/environment preconditions that gate the Candidate build and the Instance deployment, so the remaining external dependency is precise. No source change; no bypass attempted.

findings.fact: gaofeng21cn/one-person-lab-cloud .github/workflows/build-opl-cloud-candidate.yml job guard is `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner`. A dispatch by the write collaborator RenDeHuang (run 36650150455, product_sha=2dcd7e81) completed 'skipped'.
findings.consequence: The Candidate build requires the repository-owner identity (gaofeng21cn) to dispatch it from main.

findings.fact: gaofeng21cn/opl-instance-medopl .github/workflows/deploy.yml admits `... github.actor == 'RenDeHuang' ...` only on `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`, with `environment: production`. The Instance default branch is main; the local Instance checkout is on a dirty feature branch and must not be reset. preflight.yml and qualification-decision.yml also require ref main and environment production.
findings.consequence: Instance deployment requires the Instance repository's protected main with the production environment, and a qualified Candidate bound to the same product SHA. The required Candidate is the one gated by the owner above.

findings.fact: The Instance workflow inputs bind a `candidate_receipt` (the Candidate bundle) whose product SHA must match the deployed Cloud image.
findings.consequence: Stage 8 cannot start until Stage 7 produces the Candidate; both depend on the owner dispatch and the Instance protected main.

notRun: Candidate build and Instance deployment (blocked by the owner/protected-ref preconditions above).
claimBoundary: This receipt records the exact external preconditions for Stage 7/8; it claims no Candidate, no deployment and no bypass of any branch or environment gate.
